paidCheckoutWithoutOrder.subject: Alert: a paid checkout has no order — M'Arte
paidCheckoutWithoutOrder.heading: A paid checkout has no order
paidCheckoutWithoutOrder.message: Stripe took a customer's payment, but the shop could not turn the checkout into an order, and a retry would not change that. Find the payment in the Stripe Dashboard by the reference below, then refund it or arrange the order with the customer.

stripeWebhookFailed.subject: Alert: the shop failed a Stripe event — M'Arte
stripeWebhookFailed.heading: The shop failed a Stripe event
stripeWebhookFailed.message: The shop answered a Stripe event with an error, so Stripe will send it again for up to three days. Until a retry succeeds, what the event reports is missing from the shop: after a completed checkout, the customer has paid but has no order yet.

auditQueueFailed.subject: Alert: the audit log queue failed — M'Arte
auditQueueFailed.heading: The audit log queue failed
auditQueueFailed.message: The shop could not process a batch of audit log entries. The queue delivers the batch again a few times, and entries that still fail are lost. The database may be unavailable.

newsletterFailed.subject: Alert: a newsletter stopped part way — M'Arte
newsletterFailed.heading: A newsletter stopped part way
newsletterFailed.message: The shop could not send a batch of a newsletter three times and stopped the campaign, so the subscribers after the last batch that went out did not get it. Marketing in the admin panel shows how many subscribers it reached and why it stopped. Check the Resend account's status and sending quota before you send anything else.

orderEmailFailed.subject: Alert: an order email was not sent — M'Arte
orderEmailFailed.heading: An order email was not sent
orderEmailFailed.message: The shop tried an order email three times and Resend took none of them, so the customer has not received it. The reference names the email and the order or payment it belongs to. Once Resend works again, open the order in the admin panel and press Resend email on its Activity card; a failed-payment email or a withdrawal email cannot be resent from there, so write to that customer yourself.

preview: Something in the shop needs your attention.
followUp: Further failures with the same reference are not emailed for an hour. Every failure is in Workers Logs and Issues in the Cloudflare dashboard, and a paid checkout without an order is also in the audit log in the admin panel.
